We introduce EMPATHICSTORIES, a corpus of 1,500 personal stories, with crowdsourced annotations of the free-text summaries of the main event, emotion, and moral of the stories, as well as an empathic similarity score between 2,000 pairs of stories.
outputs: Generated short summaries of the main event, emotional reaction, and moral takeaway for each story.
The paper generates story embeddings and retrieves empathically similar stories; it also generates summaries of main events, emotions, and morals via LLMs and human annotators.
